venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tue 9/15 (MOD JK).** Net $2,447 vs $2,027 target (121%); food $475; no events; comps $57.40; 82 guests / $29.85 avg. Bingo Tuesday: opener set up for success, bingo started 6pm with a nice crowd at bar & booth; opener out ~8pm, barback handled a lot of prep. Strong pop ~10pm with a birthday party served through last call — bartender and barback worked well together through the rush. Kitchen chill (use it to ABK). 86 mini martini glasses, plastic cups; low High Noon. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: making the Adventure Gimlet with Tulsi — supporting local. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tue 9/15 (MOD MD / Chef JMS).** Net $2,147 vs $1,326 target (162%); event sales $1,290; food $28; comps $91.55 (4.3% — manager comp, recovery, F&F, industry, resident); 44 guests / $24.58 avg. Busy Tuesday: TPAC team arrived ~4:30pm for their post-conference event, and a second ~40-guest conference group arrived simultaneously — event practically doubled. Service well paced 5–7pm with Morgan and BT both behind the bar; after drink tickets ran out several guests opened tabs. Bingo postponed (groups not interested); a later couple got a consolation round. Slow 7:45–10pm, empty 10:30–11, then a few guests to close. John Michael executed well for the party. Maintenance: water accumulation near walk-in freezer; well 1 soda tap handle. 86 veggie dog, Guinness draft (cans available), hazy IPA. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tue 9/15 (AM Carey; PM Maggie H).** Total net incl. events $13,921.94 vs $7,877 target (177%); non-event net $7,601.94 ("AGAIN SOOOO CLOSE" to target) — DC/AM $1,226.62, D&C PM $6,181.68; net event sales $6,320 (event food $3,240); total food incl. events $5,220.70; comps $166.55; 197 guests (Tock) / ~$70.67 avg. PM: nice big pop at 6pm; thanks to Reagan for making it in time and JP for picking up the host shift; 16-top arrived 10:30pm and had a wonderful time. Events: small cocktail class for UnitedHealthcare, 12 guests 3–6pm in Suite 6A — Chef Lucas did a garden-snack & taco-bar buffet, Evan cameo for the cocktail class. Kitchen: no early pop, events smooth, late party drinks only; low lime chantilly, chicken thigh, basil vinegar, ranch, portion burgers, white bean succotash; 911 rabbit agnolotti. Break make-up complete; no-shows not charged; no incidents. Favorite moment: lots of familiar faces at Marquee. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tue 9/15 (MOD Kyler / Chef Steves).** Total EOD net $3,424 vs $3,736 target (92%); beverage $3,025; food $395; comps $257.56 (7.5% — service recovery); 143 guests (Sevenrooms) / $24 avg. DOH (health department) visited right at 8:30pm, halting service for a bit and costing a few guests — most were understanding. After DOH left the room was flat-sat: great vibe but less smooth service; by 9:30–10 filled back up with a tiny bar waitlist. Top sellers: High Plains Drifter, Rosalie, Gatlin Gun. Door: balanced reservation night, chilly (fall coming). No-shows: Griffin Harris (2, 8pm), Melissa Gomez (2, 8:15), Raimy Washington (2, 8:30) — not charged. Menu count 17/17; no breakage. Incidents: DOH visit. Entered by Stef.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Warm day, chilly night (fall is coming)
venues.narrative: **LA — Tue 9/15 (MOD Julian / Chef Saleh).** Net $3,844 vs $3,736 target (103%); Marquee $3,844 (food $673); no Standing Room or event sales; comps $51.06; 103 guests / $37.33 avg. Really slow at open, gradually picked up later — a good training day for Gracy (easing from slow to slightly busy). A 3-top grew to a 7-top; a small waitlist at one point as guests arrived one after another, all accommodated. One reservation arrived and left immediately (guest emergency). Sold a lot of cookies. Kitchen: one-man band rocked the show. Maintenance: cracked tile by host stand. 86 oat milk. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: learning more about the office side of the company; first-impression guest reactions. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tue 9/15 (MOD Marcus).** Net sales $3,271.72 vs $3,548 target (92%) — EXCLUDES the Garden event: MOD reported a Tripleseat event total of $3,628.16 (to be confirmed) and asked for help getting event net, so event revenue is not yet in the net figure. Marquee bar $3,598.94 gross; garden $72 plus event; food $354.80; comps $31.86 (investor $11.86, F&F $15, gift $5); 121 covers (63 walk-in, 40 event, 18 reso) / $38.49 avg. Cute Tuesday: Marquee slow start, biggest pop ~8:30pm with energy high until ~11. Garden popped off ~5:30 with the Jack Daniel's Whiskey Valor event — Devan hosting, Josh bartending, wrapped ~9; partial buyouts need reminders not to block the entrance/exit. Party pod group camped out and returns tomorrow for their event; late-night guests ~11pm incl. 2 investors. Kitchen: James handled event food and service food simultaneously. Went well: communication and contagious joy; improve: keep checking the pass. Maintenance: curtains. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: hosting a tasting and service at the same time; a former student in on a date. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tue 9/15 (AM Franck & Shannon; PM Justin & Drew).** Total net $9,227 vs $3,606 target (256%); Municipal Bar AM $917 / PM $4,313; Sun Club $279; Hot Eye $0; event sales $3,642; food $2,594; comps $137.30; 85 OpenTable guests (20 AM + 65 PM) / ~$108.55 avg. AM: slow morning, a couple of larger tours later were the spiciest moment of brunch. PM: bigger first half than second; possibly the largest IRD order to date for a group taking over a patio room; three servers through the rush then two to close was perfect. Aleeza trained through brunch into dinner (expo); Estella M. trained with Emma on OpenTable seating and voicemail. Sun Club: gale winds all day, no rain; good last-hour sales from vet-company affiliates not invited to the event. Event: 50 guests at Sun Club 4–6pm for VEG Out Loud veterinary social — Sierra, Skylar and Aimee ran full Broughton Package drinks and passed apps; easy set-up/clean-up, little interference with hotel pool guests. Kitchen: smooth, good early pop, no food back, no lows/86s. No incidents. Favorite moment: Jane of Savoy stopped in after the Best Of party for a "real cocktail". Entered by Justin.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tue 9/15 (MOD Curtis Hayes).** Net $10,504 vs $8,000 target (131%); food $1,329; no events; comps $679.68 (6.4% — heavy industry night, surprising level of DNLs); 216 guests / $45.67 avg. "10k Tuesdays are definitely a vibe." Pacing jerky and loose — Resy allowing too many 4-tops booked at once; following up with Zocha Group. Mark Morrison radio had people dancing. Floor ran smooth: Anne flying through server cross-training, Tessa held the larger section with ease. Bar felt the pressure but overcame ticket times as a team; waits on the longer side but most of the waitlist got in for a beverage. First night with no investors in. Kitchen: ~$1,300 — Josh prepped and stayed partway, Wes slayed. Maintenance: kitchen dishwasher broken component, Autochlor (Brian) emailed, likely fixed tomorrow. 86/low: Tenth Planet (yuzu juice), Yellow VEP, Res Naked & Famous. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: sending Kira a photo with Joe from NSH CC. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
